GetElem?.getElem?.{u, v, w} {coll : Type u} {idx : Type v} {elem : outParam (Type w)}
  {valid : outParam (coll → idx → Prop)} [self : GetElem? coll idx elem valid] : coll → idx → Option elem
GetElem?.getElem?.comment:
The syntax `arr[i]?` gets the `i`'th element of the collection `arr`,
if it is present (and wraps it in `some`), and otherwise returns `none`.
GetElem?.getElem?.description: A function is defined that safely retrieves an element from a collection at a specified index, returning an option type that indicates the presence or absence of the element.
